summary: Verified new Demo/Pilot Asset Display Limit feature for AssetNova. 14/14 backend pytest tests pass (workspace demo fields, admin exemption, non-admin caps per category & per asset-type, deterministic selection, states/alarms/work-orders scoping, featured-toggle admin-only + effect visible in demo scope, client portfolio intersecting demo, workspace mode switch restoring full data). Frontend UI verified: workspace banner shows 'Showing 5 representative assets per category for this demo.' for non-admin (assetmgr) with data-testid='demo-asset-limit-note' present; admin sees NO such note. Fleet Admin page shows 380 star-toggle buttons (data-testid='fleet-admin-featured-btn') on Sites tab for admin, and 0 for non-admin (correctly admin-gated). Assetmgr overview shows 40 sites/351 assets (demo-scoped) while admin sees 380 sites/5473 assets. Workspace mode switch to production restored full data for non-admin, then reverted to demo. All test-mutated state restored (featured toggles reverted, workspace mode left in demo).
critical_code_review_comments: demo_scope._cache is a process-local module dict — if backend is scaled to multiple workers, cache invalidation via bump_demo_cache() will only affect the worker that received the write, so other workers may serve stale featured toggles for one request cycle. Not a bug now (single worker), but worth documenting.

get_demo_asset_id_set caches by tuple(sorted(site_ids)) but only stores ONE cached value at a time — repeated calls alternating between different site_id subsets will thrash the cache. Fine for current usage.
seed_data_creation: None; only transient toggles that were reverted, and a workspace mode switch that was reverted back to 'demo'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_demo_scope.py covers the entire demo-scope feature (14 tests). Uses PATCH /workspace with required fields {mode, scenario, features}. Client portfolio path is /api/client/portfolio (not /api/rbac/...). Fleet-admin has no GET /sites list endpoint — use /api/fleet/sites (admin unrestricted). Workspace is expected to be in 'demo' mode by default; do not leave it in production.
